statement: Four jars and twenty botanical-looking drawings are recorded in horizontal groups, left to right within each group. Connected parts of a drawing are grouped together. Descriptions use visible shape and pigment. Only the ZL locus identifiers and their line types were consulted. Labels are assigned by position. The assignments around the fourth and fifth botanical drawings of row three are crowded, so the red drawing is left unlinked and the blue and brown drawing is linked to the inscription immediately to its upper right. The two unused candidate loci are f99v.29 and f99v.30.
